baseline.policy: Use the current broad-market price-floor, low-extension, high-volatility trend-persistence paper eligibility and score with its frozen universe, next-open clock, notional, costs and exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing paper cash slot; positive-contribution ticker share below 40%; no portfolio allocation, production signal or order effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commission and slippage assumptions at identical notional; no financing, borrow credit or option carry
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: TXG common stock for the current lead; any future cohort remains long common equity only, with no option, leverage, inverse product, proxy or short leg
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical OHLCV, next-regular-session-open availability, gap-cancel, stale-price and minimum-liquidity controls must pass
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Filing acceptance, revenue-source fields, price inputs, universe membership and any independent utilization evidence must be known before each simulated decision open

candidates.falsifier: Reject or park if active-base and consumables definitions cannot be frozen as-known; if no vendor-resolved independent utilization proxy exists; if the event-to-price transmission is not identified; if any standard window has fewer than five executable treatment decisions; if D0-D3 finds a frozen near-neighbor; if one issuer contributes more than 40% of positive treatment value; or if H10 and H20 replacement value does not beat cash, SPY, QQQ and the unconditioned broad-market row after identical costs.
candidates.hypothesis: For a current broad-market price-leadership candidate in life-science tools, when the latest source-dated pre-decision filing shows positive year-over-year consumables revenue, a non-declining consumables share of product-and-services revenue and non-growing instrument revenue, the price move may reflect installed-base utilization rather than episodic equipment shipments; keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged, use the operating condition only as a deterministic research admission tag, and evaluate the current TXG lead from the next regular-session open over fixed H10 and H20 replacement value.
candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact unconditioned broad-market paper row at the same decision clock, notional, costs and exit policy.
candidates.title: TXG recurring-consumables pull-through continuation lead

treatment.policy: Keep broad-market eligibility and score unchanged. For life-science-tools observations only, attach a research admission tag when the latest source-dated filing known before the decision open reports positive year-over-year consumables revenue, a non-declining consumables share of product-and-services revenue and non-growing instrument revenue; otherwise abstain. Evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The Q2 mix figures and the price reaction are public. A residual edge can exist only if investors underweight recurring utilization relative to volatile instrument shipments, and it must survive independent-evidence, PIT, touch-density, novelty, concentration and exact replacement-value tests rather than rely on the issuer narrative.
